chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong, the trustworthy.”

He said: “Shu'ayb عليه السلام said to her: My daughter, this one is strong—you recognized that from his lifting the rock. But from where did you know that he is trustworthy? She said: O my father, I walked in front of him, and he said: Walk behind me, and if I lose the way, then direct me to the path, for we are a people who do not look at the backs of women.”

key_terms.أَدْبَارِ النِّسَاءِ: The backs of women; mentioned here in the context of modest conduct and restraint of the gaze.
key_terms.الْأَمِينُ: The one who is trustworthy, morally reliable, and safeguards propriety.
key_terms.الْقَوِيُّ: The one possessing physical strength and capability.
key_terms.بِرَفْعِ الصَّخْرَةِ: By lifting the rock, which demonstrated physical strength.
key_terms.فَأَرْشِدِينِي إِلَى الطَّرِيقِ: Guide me to the path if I lose the way.

ai.seo_question: How did Shu'ayb’s daughter know that Musa عليه السلام was both strong and trustworthy?
ai.summary: This narration explains the meaning of the Quranic description of Musa عليه السلام as both strong and trustworthy. His strength was seen in lifting the rock, while his trustworthiness was shown through his modest conduct and refusal to look at a woman as she walked ahead of him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4974 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Abu Al-Hasan (as) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic: "O' my father, hire him!
Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and trustworthy" (Surah Al-Qasas, 28:26).

Imam (as) said: "Shu'ayb (as) said to his daughter, My daughter, he is strong as you recognized by his lifting of the rock, but how did you know he is trustworthy?'
She replied: O' my father, I was walking ahead of him, and he said to me, Walk behind me, and if I go astray, guide me to the path, for we are a people who do not look at the backs of women.'"
